label: Lenovo ThinkStation P3 Tower
description: Workstation tower with 13th-gen Core K or Xeon W, 1GbE RJ45 and up to four PCIe expansion slots.
notes: 1GbE RJ45 onboard; Lenovo sells Wi-Fi 6E as an add-in option only. Wired 1G by default - pair it with a 2.5G/10G NIC only if you add a PCIe card, which this model does not ship with.
